question: To round 2.46 to one decimal place, look at the hundredths digit, 6, and add 1 to the tenths digit. What is the tenths digit 4 plus 1? Calculate: \(4+1=?\)
solution: When the hundredths digit is at least 5, add 1 to the tenths digit. Here \(4+1=5\), so the approximate value is \(2.5\). The question asks for the new tenths digit, which is \(5\).
